item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Christine and the Queens - Chaleur Humaine (Atmos)
item.description:
A couple of years ago I downloaded from here the album in Atmos, kindly shared by @SonMaxime

The problem I have with it is that volume all over the place. I tried everything but some tracks were entirely too loud (a problem I don't have with any other album).

Now I've investigated this in depth and there something seriously wrong with it.

Look at the third track, Christine, opened in Audacity:



All the red you see in the waveform are clipping portions, where volume was mastered too high, leading to distortion.

For comparison, this is the same track, from the CD, in stereo:



As you can see, on the CD the track is mastered "hot", it's a pop track, not much dynamic range. But no clipping either. It's almost uniformly loud but never clipping (distorting).
The Atmos version shared here has clipping on pretty much all tracks, except the first two. Probably a mastering error, somehow.

I was wondering if anybody could source the Atmos release again. Maybe, in the meantime, they have updated the files. Were it available on disc I would buy it instantly...
